title: Nodes & Containers
description: Node and container metrics for inventory-managed hosts with a shared node filter. Container CPU is measured in cores, not divided by CPUs on unrelated hosts.

list.name: container
list.label: Container

query.query: query_result(count by (name) (label_replace(docker_container_mem_usage{job="telegraf", node=~"$node", container_name!=""}, "name", "$1", "container_name", "(.+)")) or count by (name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor", node=~"$node", image!="", name!=""}))

list.definition: query_result(count by (name) (label_replace(docker_container_mem_usage{job="telegraf", node=~"$node", container_name!=""}, "name", "$1", "container_name", "(.+)")) or count by (name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor", node=~"$node", image!="", name!=""}))

targets.expr: avg by (node) (100 - cpu_usage_idle{job="telegraf", cpu="cpu-total", node=~"$node"}) or on (node) (100 * (1 - avg by (node) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="nodeexporter", mode="idle", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))))

max by (node) (100 * (1 - mem_available{job="telegraf", node=~"$node"} / mem_total{job="telegraf", node=~"$node"})) or on (node) max by (node) (100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node"}))

max by (node, mountpoint) (label_replace((100 * (1 - disk_free{job="telegraf", node=~"$node"} / disk_total{job="telegraf", node=~"$node"})) and (disk_total{job="telegraf", node=~"$node"} > 0), "mountpoint", "$1", "path", "(.+)")) or on (node, mountpoint) max by (node, mountpoint) (100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs"}) and (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs"} > 0))

panels.title: Network traffic
panels.description: Interface-sum heuristic: VPN/bridge paths may double-count traffic. Filter to specific uplinks if exact host throughput is needed.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (rate(net_bytes_recv{job="telegraf", node=~"$node", interface!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval])) or on (node) sum by (node) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (node) (rate(net_bytes_sent{job="telegraf", node=~"$node", interface!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval])) or on (node) sum by (node) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: CPU count
panels.description: Logical CPUs per node, including hardware threads.

targets.expr: max by (node) (system_n_cpus{job="telegraf", node=~"$node"}) or on (node) count by (node) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node", mode="idle"})

panels.title: Available disk space
panels.description: Space available to normal users per filesystem, excluding reserved blocks. Values automatically scale to GiB/TiB.

targets.expr: max by (node, mountpoint) (label_replace(disk_free{job="telegraf", node=~"$node"}, "mountpoint", "$1", "path", "(.+)")) or on (node, mountpoint) max by (node, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs"})

panels.title: Load average (1 / 5 / 15 minutes)
panels.description: Unnormalized load averages; compare with the node's logical CPU count.

targets.expr: max by (node) (system_load1{job="telegraf", node=~"$node"}) or on (node) max by (node) (node_load1{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node"})
max by (node) (system_load5{job="telegraf", node=~"$node"}) or on (node) max by (node) (node_load5{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node"})
max by (node) (system_load15{job="telegraf", node=~"$node"}) or on (node) max by (node) (node_load15{job="nodeexporter", node=~"$node"})

sum by (node, name) (label_replace(docker_container_cpu_usage_percent{job="telegraf", cpu="cpu-total", node=~"$node", container_name=~"$container"} / 100, "name", "$1", "container_name", "(.+)")) or on (node, name) sum by (node, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor", node=~"$node", image!="", name!="", name=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Container memory (working set)
panels.description: Telegraf: Docker usage minus inactive file cache (v1 total_inactive_file or v2 inactive_file), clamped at zero. Falls back to raw usage when the kernel omits both cache fields; use raw Docker memory on the Telegraf dashboard to investigate differences.

targets.expr: sum by (node, name) (label_replace(clamp_min(docker_container_mem_usage{job="telegraf", node=~"$node", container_name=~"$container"} - (docker_container_mem_total_inactive_file{job="telegraf", node=~"$node", container_name=~"$container"} or docker_container_mem_inactive_file{job="telegraf", node=~"$node", container_name=~"$container"} or 0 * docker_container_mem_usage{job="telegraf", node=~"$node", container_name=~"$container"}), 0), "name", "$1", "container_name", "(.+)")) or on (node, name) sum by (node, name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor", node=~"$node", image!="", name!="", name=~"$container"})

sum by (node, name) (label_replace(rate(docker_container_net_rx_bytes{job="telegraf", node=~"$node", container_name=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval]), "name", "$1", "container_name", "(.+)")) or on (node, name) sum by (node, name) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="cadvisor", node=~"$node", image!="", name!="", name=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (node, name) (label_replace(rate(docker_container_net_tx_bytes{job="telegraf", node=~"$node", container_name=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval]), "name", "$1", "container_name", "(.+)")) or on (node, name) sum by (node, name) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="cadvisor", node=~"$node", image!="", name!="", name=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval]))
